rca of the issue: RCA: RegisterIn Pydantic model definition (line 99) did not declare the 13 expanded profile fields (date_of_birth, gender, address, emergency_contact, roll_no, class_name, section, qualification, subjects, experience_years, designation, child_roll_no, child_name) but the register handler (line 261-266) accessed them via data.<field>. Pydantic v2 raises AttributeError on missing attributes instead of silently returning None, so every /api/auth/register call returned 500 Internal Server Error. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with any valid body -> 500; backend log shows 'AttributeError: RegisterIn object has no attribute date_of_birth'. Mitigation applied: added all 13 fields as Optional[...] = None to RegisterIn. Verified by successful student/teacher/parent registrations in backend_test.py with profile verification assertions.
